hub_subtitle: Medical English to welcome guests and present with confidence

lesson.menu_title: Taking Care of Guests -- Offers with I'll
lesson.menu_desc: Block 3 continues. Plan the visit of the doctors from Toronto and offer help: I'll meet you, I'll show you, I'll arrange a room. I won't be late, I promise. A reading of the visit email, two voice messages, and three role-plays. -- 28 slides
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 22 -- Taking Care of Guests
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Graziele Dias | Lesson 22 -- Taking Care of Guests
lesson.grammar_point: will for offers and promises (I'll / I won't)

paras: Dear Doctor Carter, thank you for your email. We are very happy about your visit on Thursday. Here is the plan for the day.

Our driver will meet you at the airport at eight, and he will take you to the hotel. At ten thirty, I will meet you at reception, and I'll give you your badges. Then I'll give you a short tour of the hospital.

After the tour, we will have lunch with the team. I'll arrange a room for your presentation in the afternoon. If you need anything, I'll help you. I promise. Best regards, Graziele Dias, Nurse Coordinator.
reading.source: Email from Graziele Dias to Dr. Carter (Toronto) -- A1 reading

listenings.text: Hi Graziele, this is Doctor Carter. Thank you for the plan. It looks great. One small change: our flight arrives at nine, not at eight. Could the driver come at nine? And one more thing: Doctor Lee doesn't eat meat. Thank you for the lunch. See you on Thursday.

Hi Graziele, it is Ana. A quick tip about offers. When you decide to help in the moment, say I'll. I'll call the driver. I'll get you a coffee. I'll send the email now. I'll is short for I will. After I'll, use the simple verb, with no to. Keep it simple. You will do great.

extra_audio.text: Graziele explains the plan for the visit. First, the driver will meet the doctors at the airport. Then, he will take them to the hotel. Next, Graziele will meet them at reception with their badges. After that, she will give them a tour of the hospital. Finally, they will have lunch with the team.
